results: prototype edit, order and pause entry points open a clearly local proposal while claimed server entries remain protected
editing and reordering change only the local copy and never the real queue order or RPC state
pause freezes only local edits and real refresh does not erase the proposal
copy transfers text and delivery to an explicit draft and protects existing draft content without enqueueing
opening a different snapshot requires an explicit choice and retaining it preserves the local edits
proposal edits, order and queue drafts survive closing but remain isolated between sessions
local proposal controls remain readable within mobile bounds and preserve the fixed queue footer
only explicit enqueue sends one real command; proposal actions never pause, edit, cancel or prompt the node
